Original-library polyphase regression fixtures

resampling-dsp.json.gz contains six synthetic 400 ms float32 inputs at
24,000 / 44,100 / 48,000 Hz and reference shifted-dB spectra at 8,000 / 16,000 Hz.
Generated using installed Voice Tools 2.0.186 DevExtras.Common.Audio.dll with
Apple Accelerate, quality 2. DLL SHA-256:
fe3a1c4e087f0d68e99b97e121b1d97681afcfc631adcdaabdde933634d875a9

Each input combines a 125 Hz sine, a sine at 47.5% of the target rate, seeded
System.Random noise, DC offset, and an impulse at 200 ms. Original resampling
precedes original padded-buffer DC removal, 64 ms periodic Hann, twice-window
FFT, amplitude dB conversion plus 92. Reference spectra cover frame centres
32–288 ms in 16 ms increments, retaining input context on the right.
No proprietary executable code is included.

Integer-ratio paths are checked to 0.001 dB. At 44.1 kHz, native accumulated
fractional phase and phase-bank wrap rounding produce small non-bit-identical
results. The fixtures bound differences to 0.7 dB for bins above -72 dB and
0.12 dB for peaks above -52 dB. These are explicit limits, not full phone parity.
